description: VS Code/Open VSX Extension Submission: discover, prepare, submit, and evidence Open VSX / Visual Studio Marketplace publication for mchs-tools.

package_evidence.marketplace_sync_package_result: npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies packaged mchs-tools-0.1.1.vsix with 6 files, 4.42 KB; the public Marketplace Gallery API separately verifies published version 0.1.1.
package_evidence.discovery_result: Open VSX returned HTTP 404 Extension not found from https://open-vsx.org/api/edithatogo/mchs-tools with Accept: application/json on 2026-05-26; Visual Studio Marketplace returned HTTP 404 for the item page and 0 extensions from Gallery extensionquery; the earlier Open VSX HTTP 406 was caused by an incorrect GitHub vendor Accept header.
package_evidence.credential_attempt: 2026-06-13 Chrome evidence shows Open VSX Access Tokens available for edithatogo after Eclipse Publisher Agreement recognition. A fresh token was generated for the publish check, ovsx publish reported edithatogo.mchs-tools 0.1.0 is already published, the public Open VSX API returned namespace edithatogo, name mchs-tools, version 0.1.0, and the fresh token was deleted afterwards; an older pre-existing Open VSX token row was left untouched.
package_evidence.local_token_probe: No persistent local OVSX_PAT is required after verification; the fresh browser-created token was deleted after the publish check.
package_evidence.live_browser_setup_probe: 2026-06-13 Chrome evidence: Open VSX user settings are logged in as edithatogo, Access Tokens can be generated, a fresh token named mchs-tools publish 2026-06-13 was generated, ovsx publish returned that edithatogo.mchs-tools 0.1.0 is already published, and the fresh token was deleted. 2026-06-16 Chrome evidence: Visual Studio Marketplace publisher edithatogo is signed in as d.a.mordaunt@gmail.com and shows MCHS Tools version 0.1.1 as Public.
package_evidence.local_surface: Concrete VS Code commands read the registry-gate contract, open the language registry contract and external-gates roadmap, and copy the gated Open VSX publish command.

marketplace_publication.latest_synchronization: Open VSX latest and Visual Studio Marketplace latest both expose version 0.1.1.

package_evidence.latest_public_probe: 2026-06-16: Open VSX API https://open-vsx.org/api/edithatogo/mchs-tools returns namespace edithatogo, name mchs-tools, latest version 0.1.1, and allVersions including 0.1.1, 0.1.0, and latest; Visual Studio Marketplace Gallery extensionquery returns public edithatogo.mchs-tools version 0.1.1 with VSIX SHA-256 1d20feaa22e66978d5259dfb7b83467ed803a776d3fcb101792f2f164a2807ad.
